Use only nonsensitive details you are authorized to share. Keep real datasets,
private project identities and credentials out of this issue. A proposal does not
assign a maintainer, approve support or commit to an implementation date.

## Repeated real need

- Which repeated independently observed blocker would this resolve?
- Sanitized issue/observation references and distinct project contexts:
- Why are existing supported APIs/adapters insufficient?

## Ownership and evidence

- Willing owner and backup, or explicitly pending:
- Permitted representative corpus and independent expectations:
- Positive, different, invalid, unsupported and incomplete cases:
- Relevant Decimal, NULL/NaN, keys, multiplicity and temporal requirements:

## Cost and proposed support boundary

- Implementation and ongoing maintenance/resource budget, or pending:
- Proposed versions/platforms, native execution, stability and limitations:
- Evidence/security/upgrade implications and deprecation or exit plan:
- Component-owner and support-decision approval: pending until actually given
